tagline: Bills into Tally, and books that tie: Assurance Console and Invoice Bridge, on one computer
brief: The house the two apps live in: one program for a small Indian business's books - its bills and bank statements posted into Tally, and the month checked against GSTR-2B, the bank and its parties. For the owner as much as the accountant: plain words, nothing uploaded. A sibling of Assurance Console's maroon and Invoice Bridge's ink, in the gold both share.
criteria: Success: says finality without a tick, a shield or a rupee sign; clear at 16 px; one colour; at home beside the two marks it holds.

concepts.name: Nothing More
concepts.idea: /- : what is written after an amount so that nothing can be added to it. The last word on a figure.
rationale: Every Indian bill and cheque ends its amount with it: the figure is final, as the books should be
A 60 degree slash and a bar, flat ends - the family's vocabulary - and it half-reads as an A
The gold Assurance Console and Invoice Bridge share, as the ground both live on, with their ink

recommendation: Nothing More - chosen. Ink on light, gold on dark, ink on the gold tile; a heavier small cut for 16-48 px.
next_steps: The full installer carries the new Windows icon
